a0346.reason: Cave figures were out of date: the Quintana Roo Speleological Survey list (updated 19 January 2025) gives Ox Bel Ha 496.8 km and Sac Actun 379.6 km, so 'more than 430 km' became 'more than 490 km (as of 2025)' and the table row 'over 490 km and 379 km (2025)'. a0564.reason: The body claimed the 2003 standard (HD 308 S2 / DIN VDE 0293-308) gave each phase its own colour with L1 brown, L2 black, L3 grey. The standard only prescribes brown, black and grey for the phases and does not say which is L1, L2 or L3; L1 brown / L2 black / L3 grey is the usual assignment (a cable maker even suggests L1 black / L2 brown). The sentence now says so in all three languages.
Added a note that the standard does not fix the L1/L2/L3 order and that L1 brown, L2 black, L3 grey is the usual assignment.

w02819.reason: The question attributed L2 = black to DIN VDE 0293-308, which does not assign colours to individual phases. It now asks which colour usually marks L2 in a modern European five-core cable (black in the usual assignment).
